}}'''Gregana''' was a ''[[sul'dam]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gregana}}

== Activities ==
She is sent on the [[Seanchan]] raid to the [[White Tower]]. She places an ''[[a'dam]]'' on a shielded [[Adelorna Bastine]]. Adelorna is released by [[Egwene al'Vere]], who snaps the ''a'dam'' open in one weave then burns Gregana in a cinder in the next.
